description: This file defines the TaxClassService interface, which declares methods for managing TaxClass entities within the application, including listing by store and retrieving by code.

classes.name: TaxClassService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService with methods specific to TaxClass management, including listing tax classes for a store and retrieving by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all TaxClass instances associated with a specific MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its unique code, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code within the context of a specific MerchantStore, may throw a ServiceException.
